Name: Prophet's Rugs
Author: TheDeafProphet
Description:
[size=3]Okay, calling these rugs done before I spend another week thinking of more variations, ha! At long last I present: Rugs. These were originally going to be part of my [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27903]Dining Room Set[/url][size=3], but I decided to make it seperate so I could focus on the variations. [/size]

[size=3]You can see the different types of rugs offered and their colour options via alternative textures in the images provided! I had a lot of fun making these, and I hope y'all enjoy them for your game as well.
[/size]

[size=3][b]How to use mod: [/b]Install the files here (both the CP and the AT version) and then make sure you also have content patcher or alternative textures installed! (And smapi, of course) 
[/size]
[b]How To Acquire Items:[/b][size=3] Either use an item spawner like CJB's or you can download[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27897] the furniture catalogue[/url][size=3] I made just for this purpose! [/size]

[size=3][url=https://bsky.app/profile/prophetmods.bsky.social]Come say hi on bluesky[/url] if you wanna see what I'm up to in the meantime! I'm a bit more responsive there

[/size]and if you would like to support me...
[url=https://ko-fi.com/prophetmods]I recently made a ko-fi ! All the cool kids are doing it
[/url]
[size=2]

My usual disclaimer that I am an artist and not a top-tier programmer, so while its working on my end, if theres a unique issue on your side I don't know if I can help~[/size]

Downloads.Description: Don't forget to download the required mods too! o7
